contexts.text: In Kirjath-arba, this is Hebron in the Land of Canaan () = in the Church; (for) Kirjath-arba = the Church as to truth.

As to Kirjath-arba which is Hebron, it was the region where dwelt Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Illustrated. From the representation of these three... it is evident that Kirjath-arba which is Hebron represented the Church before Jerusalem did so.

That in course of time every Church decreases, until nothing of faith and charity remains, and that it is then destroyed, was represented by Kirjath-arba which is Hebron, in that it was possessed by the Anakim. Illustrated.

It is there called Kirjath-arba this is Hebron, because by Kirjath-arba is signified the Church as to truth, and by Hebron, the Church as to good. Here, however, it is no longer called Kirjath-arba, but Hebron, because it treats of one who is regenerate, who no longer acts from truth but from good.
Mamre Kirjath-arba () = the state of the Natural as to truth... Kirjath-arba = the Church as to truth, thus truth.
